notes.title: General Game Updates
notes.content:
Brian moved to the countryside and was able to get a spacious house, but he didn't realize that it also had some unwelcome guests.

To summarize this update, we've added four events to increase the sense of dread and tension in the early parts of the game, which can be a bit boring. No longer will the guests leave you alone to solve the puzzles in the house.


[h2]Detailed description[/h2]
※ The following may be somewhat of a spoiler.
[list]
[*] You can now turn off the TV with the remote control.
[*] Sometimes I hear dishes rattling in my kitchen [spoiler]is something living in my fridge?[/spoiler]
[*] While solving the chess puzzle, [spoiler]guests appear at regular intervals (twice) [/spoiler]
[*] The package sent by the mysterious man is [spoiler]suspicious. What could it possibly contain? [/spoiler] 
[*] Fixed playtime being displayed incorrectly.
[/list]

notes.title: Game Minor Update
notes.content:
Mainly, we improved the parts that interfered with the game progress and adjusted the difficulty of the mid-to-late half of the game.


[h2]Details[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where the puzzle could not be solved even if the chess pieces were placed normally.
[*]In the area where the 4th floor mannequins appear, the number of places that can be passed has been increased and the number of mannequins has been reduced.
[*]Reduced the durability of obstacles blocking the path on the 4th floor.
[*]Reduced monster movement speed. 5% down
[*]basements, Increased flashlight visibility in dungeon areas. Old Sight 9 -> 12 Vision
[*]The usage instructions of the RoadFlare have been made more clear.
[*]When loading the game, hints for progressing through the game are displayed in the center of the screen.
[*]The texture has been modified so that the confused magic theory book can be more clearly distinguished.
[*]Adjusted the volume of wind noise and window opening sounds.
[/list]

notes.title: The full version of "Where Is Sarah?" has been released!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44386234/fffa5ef3c11738b30552fd2d5fab1dca43654000.png[/img]
In the full version, most of the problems raised in the demo version were solved, but the biggest problem was the English translation.

[h2]Improve English translation[/h2]
[list]
[*]A new translator was found.
[/list]
A new translator was hired and the English translation was somewhat literal or unnatural sentences were corrected.
However, please understand that there are differences between the script of the voice actors and the subtitles in the game.
So, as a small apology, we are going to offer a 10% discount to commemorate the launch for about a week until August 14th.

[h2]Save and load support[/h2]
[list]
[*]As you progress through the game and reach checkpoints, they are automatically saved.
[*]Those who have cleared the demo version can continue playing the game.
[*] Cloud save is supported, so you can continue playing on other devices.
[/list]
[h3] Minor fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*]You can now move items within your inventory.
[*]Improved anti-aliasing that was hard and unpleasant to look soft.
[*]Fixed a bug where players would fall through the floor in certain areas.
[*]Fixed the confusing keypad puzzle to make it easier to understand.
[*] Slightly increased the movement speed of the character.
[/list]

When we released the demo version, many users played it and gave us feedback and problems with the game. Thanks to this, we were able to remove elements that hindered the progress of the game and catch a lot of bugs. Thanks to everyone who tested the game and promoted it through videos.


Finally, make sure to find Sera, who disappeared, and I hope you enjoy this game~!! Good luck :)
